My complaint is not because an instructor of IE background is leading the course, it's because CS students need an instructor from a CS background. It's an insulting realization every time to see that all of the INTERESTING topics in the book directly related to CS have been scraped clean off of the syllabus, and naturally the lectures themselves. I have no option but to complete my study of discrete math during the summer as I go through all of the skipped topics that would have made direct contributions to my proficiency in many things CS.
